headline: Anthropic’s safety warnings may have just backfired — the government has pulled the plug on its most powerful AI
context: Anthropic isn't hiding its frustration. "We disagree that the finding of a narrow potential jailbreak should be cause for recalling a commercial model deployed to hundreds of millions of people," the company wrote in a blog post.
